sections.heading: WoW Forever Retribution Paladin Leveling Build Overview
paragraphs: This historical WoW Forever Retribution Paladin leveling example spent 31 points in Retribution and 20 points in Holy, with no points in Protection. It reached Twist of Light in the 69913-era tree. The reviewed 70245 tree omits Crusade node 110883, so this allocation is preserved as a comparison rather than a current recommended route. No official Crusade removal note is claimed.

The 20/0/31 summary and individual ranks below record that earlier client snapshot. The calculator opens blank from this page instead of silently loading a potentially obsolete 51-point allocation. The separate Level 20 starting snapshot remains available as an editable 11-point route under the official Level 30 cap, not a completed current-cap build.

sections.heading: What the 31 Retribution Points Include
paragraphs: The Retribution route begins with Deflection and Benediction before adding Improved Judgement, Holy Conduit, and Conviction. Sanctified Judgement, Seal of Command, and Pursuit of Justice continue through the middle rows, while Sacred Arbiter and Crusade add further offensive choices. One rank in Two-Handed Weapon Specialization and one in Vengeance lead into Twist of Light, the deepest selected talent in this example.

Twist of Light is one of the newer entries shown in the WoW Forever Beta client data, documented from Beta client build 1.60.1.69913. Crusade is client-confirmed absent from the reviewed 70245 tree, so this full allocation is not presented as a present Beta build.

sections.heading: Why the Build Adds 20 Holy Support Points
paragraphs: Instead of a Protection secondary, this full-build example places its 20 remaining points into the early Holy rows: Divine Strength, Divine Intellect, Healing Light, Spiritual Focus, Improved Seals, and Unyielding Faith. The result is a Retribution-first route with a light support base, which keeps the build focused on solo damage while leaving a few familiar Paladin tools available during longer questing sessions.

The 20 Holy points explain the earlier planning idea rather than prescribe a current route. Players who prefer more survivability can start a new allocation with early Protection talents; the calculator immediately shows the changed branch totals.

sections.heading: Edit and Share This Retribution Leveling Build
paragraphs: The selected talents list preserves every rank of the earlier 20/0/31 setup. Open Calculator starts a blank route rather than importing under-review Crusade points into a current build.

After testing a legal combination, Copy Build Link stores the new selected talent identifiers and ranks. This page keeps the 69913-era example visible for comparison with its original ranks preserved.
